companyDescription: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy cell therapy · Deramiocel BLA — FDA AdCom Jul 29, PDUFA Aug 22, 2026 · 52-week range $4.30-$40.37 already shows how violently this name moves on trial data
priceNote: FDA Advisory Committee meets Jul 29, 2026; PDUFA target action date Aug 22, 2026 for deramiocel (cardiosphere-derived cell therapy) in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
summary: Capricor's deramiocel — a cell therapy targeting cardiomyopathy in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy, a fatal disease with no approved treatment for this specific complication — faces an FDA Advisory Committee vote Jul 29, 2026 followed by a PDUFA decision Aug 22. Analysts rate it Strong Buy with a $53.60 target (+116%). The stock's own 52-week range ($4.30 to $40.37) already shows this name can move 800%+ on trial readouts alone — a positive AdCom vote plus approval is a genuinely two-stage binary catalyst over the next 8 weeks.

catalysts.name: FDA Advisory Committee Vote — Deramiocel
catalysts.description: FDA convenes outside experts to vote on deramiocel's safety/efficacy data for treating cardiomyopathy in DMD. Non-binding, but the FDA usually follows the panel — historically the single biggest catalyst day for a cell/gene therapy stock.

catalysts.name: FDA PDUFA Decision — Deramiocel BLA
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for the deramiocel Biologics License Application. Would be the first approved cell therapy specifically for DMD-related cardiomyopathy — an area of significant unmet need.

risks: Two-stage binary — a negative AdCom vote on Jul 29 could crash the stock before the PDUFA even happens; a positive vote doesn't guarantee the Aug 22 approval follows
Accelerated-approval standards for cell/gene therapies have faced increased regulatory scrutiny industry-wide in 2025-2026
Single lead asset — deramiocel is essentially the entire company; no diversified revenue base
Extreme historical volatility (52-week range $4.30-$40.37) means the stock can also give back gains just as fast on any negative signal, including unrelated sector sentiment
Manufacturing/scale-up risk typical of cell therapies — even with approval, commercial-scale production of an allogeneic cell product is non-trivial

macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW for both binary events. Broader hawkish-Fed sentiment is a secondary drag on the multiple, not the driver of the Jul 29 / Aug 22 moves.
